trigger: Passive blessing description; visible whenever the player views active effects.
draft_prose: Y'ffre answers the kept covenant. Hunting kills restore stamina; animals never flee unprovoked. At Strict compliance, devotion gains a fifth again.

trigger: Passive blessing description; visible whenever the player views active effects.
draft_prose: Y'ffre's Mark is on you. In forest and wild, archery damage +8%; animals never flee; the first arrow of a hunt strikes true and deep.

trigger: Passive blessing description; visible whenever the player views active effects.
draft_prose: The Story is carried. Speech +5%; outdoor stamina regen +5%; poison resistance +10%.

trigger: Passive blessing description; visible whenever the player views active effects.
draft_prose: Y'ffre and the secondary gods answer the diaspora faith. Community acts return piety; nature sites and outdoor combat steady you.

trigger: Passive blessing description; visible whenever the player views active effects.
draft_prose: You carry the Story itself. Speech +10%; preserving a community or tradition returns a day of broadened skill. The dialogue of memory opens to you.

trigger: Passive blessing description; visible whenever the player views active effects.
draft_prose: Z'en weighs your dealings. Barter +5%; merchant prices improve; defending against a first-striker returns minor health.

trigger: Passive blessing description; visible whenever the player views active effects.
draft_prose: Z'en answers the settled account. Proportionate vengeance grants a day of stronger weapons; honored debts and fair trade return piety.

trigger: Passive blessing description; visible whenever the player views active effects.
draft_prose: Balance is restored through you. A debt settled or a wrong redressed returns a day of stronger skill growth; proportionate kills return stamina.

trigger: Passive blessing description; visible whenever the player views active effects.
draft_prose: The road teaches you. Pickpocket +5%; sneak +3%; a night slept outdoors sharpens the next day's first stealth.

trigger: Passive blessing description; visible whenever the player views active effects.
draft_prose: Baan Dar answers the exile. Surviving severe odds returns a burst of stamina; road-life scores; outcasts deal with you kindly.

trigger: Passive blessing description; visible whenever the player views active effects.
draft_prose: Baan Dar's luck is yours. Once a week, a survival you should not have had returns a day-long pulse of fortune; the wild road weighs heavier than the city.

trigger: HUD corner notification. One per path per save; %s deity.
draft_prose: %s has noticed your path. Observant.

trigger: HUD corner notification. One per path per save.
draft_prose: Your standing with %s is steady now. Faithful.

trigger: HUD corner notification. One per save.
draft_prose: %s knows your name. Devoted.

trigger: HUD corner notification. One per direction per save.
draft_prose: Your standing with %s has slipped to Wavering.

trigger: HUD corner notification. One per direction per save.
draft_prose: The favor of %s is thinning. Observant.

trigger: HUD corner notification. One per save per Devoted loss.
draft_prose: The bond with %s loosens. The Devoted bond is not held.

trigger: MessageBox. One-time on first Old Contract Devoted.
draft_prose: Title: "Y'ffre's Mark" Body: "You kept the Pact in exile, where no warden watched and no forest enforced it. You kept it because it is true, not because it is law. The covenant is fully yours, and the wild knows you for its own."

trigger: MessageBox. One-time on first Living Story Devoted.
draft_prose: Title: "The Story Carried" Body: "The forest could not follow you here, so you carried the Story instead -- in memory, in community, in the telling. Y'ffre is the Now held by narrative. You hold a piece of it."

trigger: MessageBox. One-time on first Exchange Devoted.
draft_prose: Title: "The Account Clean" Body: "Debt by debt, wrong by wrong, you have kept the world even. Nothing free, nothing owed, nothing left unpaid. Z'en's balance runs through you now."

trigger: MessageBox. One-time on first Bandit Road Devoted.
draft_prose: Title: "The Story by the Fire" Body: "You are the one who should not have made it -- and did, and again, and again. That is the story exiles tell in the dark. Baan Dar writes those stories, and you are in his book."

trigger: MessageBox. First-run setup; one-time.
draft_prose: Title: "The Covenant in Exile" Body: "Y'ffre made a covenant with the Bosmer. In Skyrim, far from Valenwood's enforcement, you must decide what you still carry of it. Choose your path: the Old Contract, the Living Story, the Exchange, or the Bandit Road."

trigger: HUD corner notification. On confirmed entry into Old Contract.
draft_prose: You walk the Old Contract. The Green Pact is yours to keep, in full.

trigger: HUD corner notification. On confirmed entry into Living Story.
draft_prose: You walk the Living Story. The covenant lives in memory and community.

trigger: HUD corner notification. On confirmed entry into Exchange.
draft_prose: You walk the Exchange. The world should be even, and you keep it so.

trigger: HUD corner notification. On confirmed entry into Bandit Road.
draft_prose: You walk the Bandit Road. The exile's road is your theology now.

trigger: MessageBox. Fires after three consecutive in-game days at Apostate.
draft_prose: Title: "Y'ffre Confronts You" Body: "Three days you have stood Apostate to the Pact we made. I will not let it fade in silence. Recommit, and the covenant holds. Renounce, and it is set down. Choose. There is no third answer."

trigger: MessageBox. Recommit; GreenPactCompliance snaps to 30.
draft_prose: Recommit to the Pact.

trigger: MessageBox. Renounce; first renunciation allows one re-entry.
draft_prose: Renounce the Pact.

trigger: MessageBox. Fires on second renunciation; Y'ffre ledger frozen permanently.
draft_prose: Title: "The Door Closes" Body: "You have set the Pact down a second time. There is no third taking-up. Y'ffre's ledger is closed to you now, and stays closed. The other Bosmer gods remain -- but the covenant is over."

trigger: HUD corner notification. One per band entry.
draft_prose: Compliance fallen to Apostate. Y'ffre's favor is locked; the reckoning begins.

trigger: HUD corner notification. One per band entry.
draft_prose: Compliance has slipped to Lapsed. Y'ffre's favor comes at half.

trigger: HUD corner notification. One per band entry.
draft_prose: Compliance restored to Observant. Y'ffre's favor flows full again.

trigger: HUD corner notification. One per band entry.
draft_prose: Compliance risen to Strict. Y'ffre's favor flows a fifth again stronger.

trigger: HUD corner notification. MECHANICS-BLOCKED: tag layer required. Per tagged plant item consumed; cooldown window set by implementation.
draft_prose: Plant flesh consumed. The Pact holds the count.

trigger: HUD corner notification. MECHANICS-BLOCKED: tag layer required. Fires when within implementation-defined threshold of the next downward band crossing.
draft_prose: Another plant consumed. Compliance approaches the next fall.

trigger: MessageBox. MECHANICS-BLOCKED: tag layer required. Fires on deliberate curated high-value plant consumption (ingredient hooks, not incidental food); per-event cooldown.
draft_prose: Title: "The Pact Remembers" Body: "You ate from the living world. The Pact does not argue with the hunger; it holds the record. Each plant consumed is a mark against the covenant. The count is yours to weigh; Y'ffre weighs it already."

trigger: HUD corner notification. One per lapse-band crossing.
draft_prose: The Pact is slipping, and you can feel the reckoning coming.

trigger: HUD corner notification. One per lapse-band crossing.
draft_prose: The oral tradition dries up. You have stopped carrying the Story.

trigger: HUD corner notification. One per lapse-band crossing.
draft_prose: Debts go unpaid and unnoticed. The world's balance ignores you.

trigger: HUD corner notification. One per lapse-band crossing.
draft_prose: Baan Dar's luck has gone dormant. The road is just hardship now.

trigger: Shown via Survey Devotion and on posture transitions.
draft_prose: You walk the Old Contract, the Green Pact kept in full. Standing: %s1. Compliance: %s2. Y'ffre holds you to the terms.

trigger: Shown via Survey Devotion and on posture transitions.
draft_prose: You walk the Living Story, the covenant carried in memory and community. Standing: %s. The Story passes through you.

trigger: Shown via Survey Devotion and on posture transitions.
draft_prose: You walk the Exchange, the world kept even debt by debt. Standing: %s. Z'en weighs your account.

trigger: Shown via Survey Devotion and on posture transitions.
draft_prose: You walk the Bandit Road, the exile's theology of the open road. Standing: %s. Baan Dar favors the improbable.

trigger: HUD corner notification. After-act; daily cap; proper hunting conduct.
draft_prose: A clean hunt, the Pact honored. Y'ffre's wild answers.

trigger: HUD corner notification. After-act; anti-desecration beat.
draft_prose: You turned back desecration of the living world. Counted.

trigger: HUD corner notification. After-act; non-trivial preservation.
draft_prose: Something preserved, something remembered. The Story holds.

trigger: HUD corner notification. Environmental; per site, daily cap.
draft_prose: At the grove, Y'ffre's presence is quiet and near.

trigger: HUD corner notification. After-act; honored debt or contract.
draft_prose: A debt paid, an account made even. Z'en is satisfied.

trigger: HUD corner notification. After-act; redress quest, proportionate only.
draft_prose: The wrong is redressed, no more and no less. Balance.

trigger: HUD corner notification. Environmental; road-life acts; daily cap.
draft_prose: The road keeps you. Baan Dar favors the wandering exile.

trigger: HUD corner notification. After-act; aiding other outcasts.
draft_prose: You stood by another outcast. Baan Dar marks his own.

trigger: MessageBox. Weekly cap; near-death survival or impossible escape only.
draft_prose: Title: "Baan Dar's Luck" Body: "You should not have walked away from that. You did. That is the story they will tell about you in the dark, around the fire. I gave you the ending."

trigger: MessageBox. Once on becoming vampire.
draft_prose: Title: "The Covenant and the Undead" Body: "You are undead now. The living covenant does not reach the unliving. On the Old Contract the Pact breaks at once; on the other paths the bond strains hard but holds by a thread. Y'ffre is the Now, and you have stepped outside it."

trigger: MessageBox. Once on cure.
draft_prose: Title: "Back Within the Now" Body: "The undeath is lifted. You stand within the living world again, and your path is open -- though the Old Contract, broken this way, must be retaken like any lapse."

trigger: MessageBox. Once on first transformation.
draft_prose: Title: "The Hunt Without Sanction" Body: "The beast is in you. It echoes the Wild Hunt, so Bosmer theology can read it -- but it is not Y'ffre's sanction. On the Old Contract this is a serious violation; on the other paths, contested strain. The shape is intelligible. It is not approved."

trigger: MessageBox. Once on werewolf cure; Old Contract retaken like a lapse.
draft_prose: Title: "The Hunt Set Down" Body: "The beast is set down. The unsanctioned shape leaves you, and you stand within Y'ffre's Now again. On the Old Contract the violation must be retaken like any lapse; on the other paths the strain simply eases. The Now holds."

trigger: Dialogue topic; Old Contract or Living Story path.
draft_prose: "Y'ffre's covenant is mine to carry. I keep it where Kynareth's shrine stands."

trigger: Dialogue topic; Faithful or above.
draft_prose: "I carry the Story for our people in exile. What must be remembered here?"
